communication_goal: 提供完整问题证据，让分析建立在同一上下文上。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished educational scene illustration, square canvas approximately 1024x1024. Pure solid BLACK background with crisp clean WHITE line art only. Minimalist adult stick-figure programmer with circular head, thin limbs and simple expressive face. The programmer is conversing with a recognizable official OpenAI six-loop interwoven knot logo floating nearby, drawn in white with black negative spaces; the logo itself represents the AI conversational partner and has no human body. EXACTLY ONE human programmer and ONE OpenAI logo. Single coherent scene, no panels. Restrained programmer comic aesthetic. Keep the main scene approximately x=180..820 and y=230..770 on a 0..1000 canvas. Leave generous empty black space at the top y<200 and bottom y>820 for later learning labels. Props named in the scene must be recognizable, complete and unobstructed. No colored elements, gradients, gray shading, photorealism, textures, glow. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, readable code, captions, watermark or other logos. The only brand symbol is the requested OpenAI knot. Scene: The adult stick-figure programmer sits at the left of a desk and points toward one large desktop terminal window at center. The terminal is shown as a complete rectangular screen with several short horizontal white line segments inside, all abstract and unreadable, with no letters, numbers or symbols. Keep the window unobstructed. The floating white OpenAI knot is at the right. No papers or extra monitors.

coverage_review.scope: V028 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

image_review.summary: 通过：单幅黑底白线插画，一个成年火柴人和一个 OpenAI 标识。终端窗口边界完整，内部只有不可读的抽象横线，不含代码字符；evidence、error、log 只依对白语境。
